name: BPOTech Customize Column Post Type
author: BPOTechHue

sections.description:
BPOTech Customize Column Post Type is a powerful plugin that allows you to easily customize, manage, and rearrange admin columns for your posts, pages, custom post types, and taxonomies.

With support for Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) and Smart Custom Fields (SCF), you can effortlessly display custom data directly in your admin list tables, saving you time and improving your workflow.

Features

  • Customize columns for Posts, Pages, and Custom Post Types.
  • Customize columns for Taxonomies and Users.
  • Support for ACF and SCF custom fields.
  • Enable/Disable editing, sorting, and filtering per column.
  • Easy to use drag-and-drop interface.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bpotech-customize-column-post-type directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Customize Columns’ settings page in your WordPress admin menu to configure your columns.
sections.faq:
Does it support ACF?

Yes, this plugin fully supports Advanced Custom Fields and can display your ACF data directly in the admin columns.

Can I reorder the columns?

Yes, you can easily drag and drop columns to reorder them in the settings panel.
